```yaml
name: Index Translations

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  index-translation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev] || pip install -e .[dev] --no-binary :all:
          # Fallback if dev extras are not defined
          pip install -e . || pip install -e .

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

      - name: Index translations
        run: python -m alfanous.cli --index-translation
```
